row.body: The repair key is signed out for an engine test; the customer’s road receipt says the vehicle was cleared before the test ended.
row.title: Suspension repair and route

sidecar.gloss: A vehicle is cleared before its engine test ends.
sidecar.rival_reading: A response vehicle could be repaired and cleared during a rushed evacuation; the record does not identify the engine issue.

row.body: the ball of yarn and hand torch are wedged beneath unused warning tape. footprints pass around the bundle rather than toward it.
row.title: missing count beside the ball of yarn

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
